metadata.question: Did deforestation occur in West Virginia, US, at the specific location (38.07594286088219, -81.81.97068176434179), between September 17, 1984 and June 2, 2009?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (38.07594286088219, -81.1797068176434179) - note the question has "81.81.97..." which seems like a typo, should be -81.1797... - Date range: 1984-09-17 to 2009-06-02 - Collection: Landsat 5 for this time period (1984-2009) - Need to compare forest cover at start vs end 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA bands - Calculate NDVI or use direct forest loss datasets - Hansen Global Forest Change would be ideal but covers 2000-2023, so may miss 1984-2000 period - Better approach: Calculate NDVI from Landsat 5, compare early period vs late period 3. Logic: - Get median NDVI for 1984-1985 period (early) - Get median NDVI for 2008-2009 period (late) - If NDVI decreased significantly (e.g., >0.1-0.2 decrease), deforestation occurred → A - If NDVI stable or increased → B - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-81.1797068176434179, 38.07594286088219]); const startDate = '1984-09-17'; const endDate = '2009-06-02'; // Split into early and late periods const earlyStart = '1984-09-17'; const earlyEnd = '1985-12-31'; const lateStart = '2008-01-01'; const lateEnd = '2009-06-02'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Landsat 5 function maskL5sr(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // Cloud return image.updateMask(mask); } // Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 3. Data Acquisition - Early Period let earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(earlyStart, earlyEnd) .map(maskL5sr) .map(addNDVI); const earlySize = await earlyCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Early period images: ${earlySize}`); if (earlySize === 0) { console.log('No images found for early period (1984-1985).'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Data Acquisition - Late Period let lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(lateStart, lateEnd) .map(maskL5sr) .map(addNDVI); const lateSize = await lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Late period images: ${lateSize}`); if (lateSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for late period (2008-2009).'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate median NDVI for each period const earlyNDVI = earlyCol.select('NDVI').median(); const lateNDVI = lateCol.select('NDVI').median(); // Check valid pixel count const earlyStats = await earlyNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: point, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lateStats = await lateNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: point, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const earlyCount = earlyStats['NDVI_count']; const earlyMean = earlyStats['NDVI_mean']; const lateCount = lateStats['NDVI_count']; const lateMean = lateStats['NDVI_mean']; console.log(`Early NDVI: ${earlyMean}, Pixels: ${earlyCount}`); console.log(`Late NDVI: ${lateMean}, Pixels: ${lateCount}`); if (earlyCount === 0 || lateCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (earlyMean === null || lateMean === null || earlyMean < -1 || earlyMean > 1 || lateMean < -1 || lateMean > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const ndviChange = lateMean - earlyMean; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${ndviChange.toFixed(4)}`); // Deforestation threshold: NDVI decrease > 0.15 if (ndviChange < -0.15) { console.log('Significant NDVI decrease detected - deforestation occurred.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant NDVI decrease - no deforestation detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
